tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshe dpag med lha dgu'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg ni/ thab stegs yod med ji ltar yang / sa ser pos gzhi byugs pa'i steng du thab kyi dngos gzhi'i dbus nas/ khru gang gru bzhir btab pas khru do 'byung / kha khyer mu ran stegs bu rnams la sor brgyad re'am bzhi re gang rung thab kyi dbus su lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs/ chu tshon gyis bris la dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du hrīḥre/ mu ran la rin po che'i phreng ba zla phyed dkar po/ rdo rje ser po/ 'bras bu can gyi shing ngam lci ba gtsang mas kha khyer gyi steng gru bzhi khru gang brtsigs/ dkyil 'khor gyi khyams kyi shar lhor ting lo bzhag de'i drung du nas 'bras gang rung gi tshom bu me yol gyi rgya dang dpangs 'dam phyed/ thab g.yon nas yam shing mar/ til sogs sbyin sreg spyi 'gre'i rdzas rnams kha ches ser por bsgyur/ g.yas nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod grangs tshang / 'das gtor rgyal chen phyogs skyong / 'byung po/ me lha rnams la zlum gtor ser po dar ber can re/ bgegs gtor/ rdor dril/ dgang gzar blugs/ bsangs chu 'thor yab/ ku sha brgyad/ spor lde rnams 'dus byas la mchod pa byin rlabs skyabs 'gro nas bdag bskyed kyi gzhal yas khang rang la thim pa'i bar/ bsang chu la dmigs te oṃ a mṛ ta nyer gcig mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams la gtor te/ bsang sbyang bskyed chog gi dkyil chog gi mchod pa byin rlabs bzhin la/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyang gzi brjid dang ldan pa sbyin bdag rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar dang / 'bru gsum nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa la sogs par brjod/ spor lde spor la oṃ na mo bh+rūṃ sogs lan gsum brjod cing thab la gru bzhi g.yas skor du bskor/

oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ gyis me sbar/ sngags de nyid dang dgang gzar mar khu dang bcas pa lan gsum gyis me kha gsos/ thab la a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rgyas pa'i thab khung gru bzhi ser po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa mu ran la rin po ches bskor ba'i nang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spos rdor dril 'dzin pas/ oṃ tshur byon nas bzhes slad du/ 'dir ni yang dag snyoms par mdzod/ /oṃ ag+na ye ma hā te dza sarba karma pra sa da ka ka ru ṇ+ya kṛ ta sarba ar+tha asmin pan+ni hi twa bha wa/ rdor dril bzhag thab nang du 'bru gtor/ pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ pad+ma ka ma la sogs brjod/ thab kyi dbus su pad+ma dang ra skyes kyi gdan la 'khod pa ni me lha sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng dang / g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ sku las 'od zer ser po 'phro ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ ku sha dang byon zan 'bul ba spyi dang mthun zhing / oṃ ag+nā ye a dī pyā a dī pyā a bi ṣa mahā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya swāhā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer mchod rol mo/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sh+lau ka gcig rdzas kyi rim pa ni/ yam shing mar til zas mchog dang / 'bras so nas sran gro dur wa/ ku sha rnams ni nyer gcig 'bul/ rdzas sngags spyi dang mthun no/ /spel tshig dper mtshon na/ oṃ bodhi brik+ṣa ye ko lcags lha sde mi sde/ yul grong / longs spyod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa legs pa'i yon tan thams cad/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ rdzas thams cad rdzogs nas gong ltar mchod bstod/ mar nag dgang blugs gang blugs te sngags dang me lha 'bar ba gzhan dang 'dra/

me a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa nas gtso 'khor thams cad la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan gyi bar dkyil chog bzhin/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla ma dang tha mi dad pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ snying po/ ming gi snying po/ gzungs ring rnams tshar gcig gi rjes su byon zan gyi sngags gong ji lta ba bzhin la/ ba ha na ya ko lcags sogs spel tshig sbyar ba lan gsum phul/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs nas bstod pa rdzogs pa'i bar dkyil chog bzhin/ rdzas thams cad kyi 'gor/ snying po sogs/ sngags gsum tshar re/ rdzas sngags kyis brgya rtsa brgyad phul ba'i mthar spel tshig khyad par 'bru kho na ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsams la/ oṃ na mo bh+rūṃ ā yu r+dzñā na hrīḥ a ro lika hūm̐ hrīḥ brgya rtsas phul ba'i mthar/ spel tshig sbyar ba lan bcu/ 'di'i 'bul tshul 'di bzhin nam/ yang na bsnyen dus bzhin/ 'das pa'i me lha la bsreg rdzas dang po sngags gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i rdzas sngags dang spel tshig gis phul/ gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar/ phreng ba dang 'bru la grangs bzung la phreng 'khor re/ rdzogs mtshams su thog mar grangs 'dzin gyi 'bras bu phul de nas yam shing sogs tshang ma snying pos phul ba'i mthar/ spel tshig sbyar ba ste bsnyen dus kyi sbyin sreg spyi 'gre bzhin/ 'bul tshan rdzogs mtshams rdzas sngags kyis 'bul ba'ang rigs 'gre/ mthar bum bskyed bzhin mchod bstod/ 'das gtor nas bgegs gtor btang ba'i bar dkyil chog bzhin/ nye reg bya ba'am/ ma grub na kha chus bshal la phyir 'pho/ 'das pa'i me lha la gshegs skyems gong byon zan bzhin phul/ mchod bstod bum bskyed bzhin/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis ko lcags sogs nas/ yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/

g.yas pa'i srin lag gi thab thal blangs la 'bru gsum brjod cing gnas gsum du thig le bya/ rdor sems/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs/ gang yang bdag blo sogs/ gtso bor nus pa sogs/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs/ mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtogs/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim/ me lha lhag mchod gzhan dang 'dra ba las rdzas kyi gong du mchod bstod/ gshegs skyems lan gsum phul nas kyang / mchod bstod/ gtor ma ni gong du bsgrigs pa de las thab kyi nye drung du len mi dgos/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs/ dkyil chog gi mdun bskyed bzhin/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags na maḥsarba sogs nas ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ gsum mam lnga bdun nyer gcig la sogs pas phul/ mchod pa gong bzhin/ bstod pa rgyas pa/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma nas kun 'grub shog gi bar/ ma 'byor pa dang sh+lau ka gcig bdag gi don dang sogs/ gshegs gsol spyi 'gre/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs dang / brgyud 'debs bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa sogs sam/ ston mchog dam pa'i che ba'i che mchog sogs/ gang 'os mdzad pas 'thus/ thab gcig la sgrub pa po mang pos rdzas phul na me shi ba sogs skyon 'byung bas/ thab kyang so so/ rdzas rnams kyang so sor/ gtor ma yang so sor bgyis na 'byor pa rgyas pa'i rten 'brel dang / zhal byang gzigs/ cho ga bsgrigs 'don me tshad sogs nyen che na thab dang sgrub po'i bar du 'dom bzhi lnga sogs kyis 'gyangs chod par byas la/ spor lde la'ang gzungs thag btang la sgrub g.yog gis spar/ mar sogs rdzas rnams kyang snod du bsags la sgrub g.yog rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du bskyal/ da lam gyi rdzas kyi gtso bo ni/ yam shing / mar/ zas mchog nas rnams yin zhing rdzas gzhan tsho 'byor pa chung zhing snod ma 'byor na lhan cig tu bsres nas rdzas sngags so so la grangs 'dzin bgyis pas 'gal ba med par khungs thub kyi yi ge rnams las bshad//
